concept: CloudFormation: infrastructure as code for repeatable environments
tests: Choosing a native service for reproducible infrastructure provisioning from versioned templates.
expected: AWS CloudFormation: IaC templates under version control, repeatable deployment across environments. Triggers: "identical, repeatable infrastructure", "multiple environments", "version-controlled templates", "AWS natively".
why_not: The console and ad hoc CLI aren't repeatable or tracked; SSM Run Command runs commands on instances but doesn't manage stacks.
